# Email Message

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:EmailMessage`](gmeow-EmailMessage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/EmailMessage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)

An RFC 5322 email message, with headers, participants, a thread, body parts and mailbox residence.
